text:
Emma Chen: FYI found repeatable auth/retry loop in the Next.js + LlamaIndex starter when token refresh fails during streaming. Repro steps + logs below. @Raj @Tanya :bug:

Raj Patel: Ack. Can you paste the minimal repro and the package versions?

Emma Chen: repro: clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-starters (branch: llamaindex-starter-auth) then `npm i` & `npm run dev`, open /chat, hit send. Environment: Node 18, next@13.4.6, @redwood/sdk@0.7.1, llamaindex@0.6.2. Log snippet: 

```
POST /v1/generate 401 Unauthorized
Retrying request (attempt=2) -> trigger token refresh
Refreshing token -> succeeded
Resending request -> 401 Unauthorized
...loop...
```

Tanya Gómez: hmm this looks like our SDK retry middleware retries on 401 after refresh even when the response body says 'invalid_refresh' — we should only retry if refresh succeeded and the original request had not already used the new token. Do we have telemetry to see refresh success per request?

ci-bot: deploy 1790.4 to dev completed :rocket:

Raj Patel: I can repro locally. Patch idea: add an idempotency guard + short-lived token compare. Pseudocode:

```
if (status === 401) {
  const before = auth.currentToken;
  await refresh();
  if (auth.currentToken === before) return throwAuthError();
  // set a flag so retry only once
}
```

Emma Chen: that would avoid infinite loop. Also observed streaming path wasn't setting the guard because stream reconnect uses a different codepath (stream client re-instantiates and misses the retry flag).

Samir Ortiz: I'll open a small PR to SDK that sets a retry-once-per-request flag and introduces config `retryOn401` (default true). Will also update the Next starter README with troubleshooting and add a tiny e2e for the chat flow.

Tanya Gómez: pls add a unit for the streaming client — I can help wire it into the eval-harness tests so CI can catch regressions.

Emma Chen: filing an issue for onboarding docs friction so we can add a troubleshooting section for auth loops: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-starters/issues/42 :memo:

Raj Patel: also note: Dedicated + Private customers sometimes have different token TTLs; we should doc that fallback / retry behavior is configurable per deployment.

Samir Ortiz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/210 :thumbsup: — assigning to @Tanya

Tanya Gómez: reviewing now. Small nit: prefer `retryOn401` in client config over env var. I'll leave a comment on the PR.

Emma Chen: thanks all. if we need a hotfix for hosted demo apps we can ship a patch to the starter templates today.

ci-bot: issue 42 labeled 'dx/onboarding' and assigned to Emma Chen

Emma Chen: thanks everyone :heart:
